Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H8380); the twin; Thomas, a Christian:--Thomas.
BiblicalUsage: Thomas is one of the twelve apostles, called the Twin, who would not believe until he saw the risen Christ. In Matthew 10:3, Thomas, and Matthew the publican. The fuller story is told on the Thomas profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Thomas shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families. That is why his doubt and his confession both stay with me.
